page_title: ATM 1-2 BAR | Atletico Madrid v Barcelona 04/04/2026, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' That's the end of the match.
90+5' The free kick into the penalty area from Nahuel Molina (Atl. Madrid) is cleared.
90+4' Diego Simeone (Atl. Madrid) picks up a yellow card for unsporting behaviour after the half-time whistle. He should have gone straight into the dressing room instead.

90+4' Joao Cancelo (Barcelona) escapes without any punishment from the referee after using excessive force to foul his opponent. Free kick. Atl. Madrid will probably just try to cross the ball in from here.
90+3' Taufik Seidu (Atl. Madrid) is awarded a yellow card for his tackle. He doesn't seem to agree with the decision, but Mateo Busquets ignores the protests.
90+2' Taufik Seidu (Atl. Madrid) makes a bad challenge and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
90+2' Jules Kounde (Barcelona) fails to pick a body out in the box with an over-hit chip pass.
90' 6 min. of stoppage-time to be played.

87' 1 - 2 The ball finds its way to Robert Lewandowski (Barcelona) after a confusing situation inside the goalmouth. He finds some space and easily knocks the ball in with his body and alters the score to 1:2.
87' A great solo run by Joao Cancelo (Barcelona) took him deep inside the box, but his weak effort towards the left side of the goal was easily caught by Juan Musso.
86' Lamine Yamal (Barcelona) makes some space for himself and from mid-range let's fly with a wild effort which goes high over the crossbar.
86' Mateo Busquets has a clear sight and sees a foul from Javi Morcillo (Atl. Madrid).
85' Lamine Yamal (Barcelona) delivers a promising cross into the box, but it's cleared.
84' Ferran Torres (Barcelona) latches on to a precise pass and finds himself one-on-one with the keeper, but his effort is straight at Juan Musso, who is alert and makes an easy save to deny him.
82' Flag goes up against Jules Kounde (Barcelona) and the referee blows his whistle for offside.
81' The attendance is 67710.
81' Dani Olmo (Barcelona) receives a good pass just outside the box, unleashes a strike from a promising position, but the shot is blocked by the defender.
79' Substitution. Marcus Rashford leaves the pitch and is replaced by Robert Lewandowski (Barcelona).
78' Hansi Flick prepares a substitution. Eric Garcia is replaced by Gavi (Barcelona).
78' Flag up against Marcus Rashford (Barcelona). He had space to move into behind the defence, but he went too soon.
77' Mateo Busquets blows for a foul after Jose Maria Gimenez (Atl. Madrid) was too aggressive in the battle for the ball.
76' Mateo Busquets blows his whistle. Pau Cubarsi (Barcelona) commits a foul after dangerous play.
71' Marcus Rashford (Barcelona) rolls the ball short to a teammate from the corner instead of sending a cross into the box.
71' This corner kick is taken with a short pass by Marcus Rashford (Barcelona).
71' The ball is cleared after Marcus Rashford (Barcelona) attempted to dribble past an opposing player. The ball is out of play and Barcelona manage to earn a corner.
71' Marcus Rashford (Barcelona) decides to speed play up with a short corner kick.

71' A defender unwittingly blocks the ball on the line after a snap shot from Joao Cancelo (Barcelona) inside the box following a slide rule pass. Barcelona force a corner. Their opponents will face another attacking threat.
70' Marcus Rashford (Barcelona) decides to take a short corner instead of crossing into the box.

70' Ferran Torres (Barcelona) collects a great pass inside the box and misses a sitter. His shot was directed towards the left post, but the goalkeeper pulls off a marvellous diving save and denies him. Barcelona will have a chance to score from a corner kick.
68' Taufik Seidu (Atl. Madrid) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Clement Lenglet.

67' Ferran Torres (Barcelona) receives a precise pass and is given time inside the box to send a promising strike towards the middle of the goal. Juan Musso guesses his intention and denies him with a fine save.
65' A quickly taken corner by Barcelona.
65' Pedri (Barcelona) fails to pick a body out in the box with an over-hit chip pass.
65' Barcelona take a short corner instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.

65' Joao Cancelo (Barcelona) misses a good chance to score. An inch-perfect cross into the box finds Joao Cancelo (Barcelona) who rises for a header, but sends the ball well over the bar. The referee and one of his assistants signal for a corner kick to Barcelona.
64' Joao Cancelo (Barcelona) finds himself in a promising position after receiving a precise pass. He pulls the trigger but only hits one of the opposition, who gets in the way of his effort.
63' Mateo Busquets couldn't ignore the rough tackle by Dani Olmo (Barcelona) and blew his whistle.
62' Marc Bernal is substituted due to injury. Hansi Flick gives a chance to Jules Kounde (Barcelona).
61' We are about to witness a substitution. Alexander Sorloth (Atl. Madrid) is replacing Giuliano Simeone.
61' Substitution. Javi Morcillo (Atl. Madrid) has come on for Antoine Griezmann.
61' Here is a change. Alex Baena is going off and Diego Simeone gives the last tactical orders to Jose Maria Gimenez (Atl. Madrid).
60' Lamine Yamal (Barcelona) decides to keep the ball to himself and weaves through the defence into the box. From there he takes a shot which goes narrowly wide of the target.
58' Good chance! Pedri (Barcelona) nicely turned his man inside the box but placed his effort just wide of the right post. He should have scored!
58' Barcelona take a short corner kick.

57' Dani Olmo (Barcelona) sees an unmarked teammate and attempts to send him a low pass. However, one of the defenders reads the game perfectly and averts the danger. Barcelona have been awarded a corner kick.

56' Lamine Yamal (Barcelona) must feel embarrassed now. He received a killer pass, but his shot from the six-yard box was a disaster. He miskicked and made it very easy for Juan Musso to get hold of the ball.
54' Lamine Yamal (Barcelona) fails to convert the free kick from the edge of the box. His shot goes right into the stands. High, wide and not at all handsome.
53' Mateo Busquets shows a yellow card to Clement Lenglet (Atl. Madrid) for a tough tackle.
52' Alex Baena (Atl. Madrid) deprives his opponent of the ball, but the referee blows his whistle for a foul. He's not happy with the decision!
51' Antoine Griezmann (Atl. Madrid) times his run too early and the linesman raises his flag for offside.
50' Juan Musso (Atl. Madrid) receives a yellow card from the referee for dissent.
50' Big moment in the game as the red card awarded to Gerard Martin (Barcelona) is reduced to a yellow following the VAR review!

49' It's been a while since that contentious challenge by Gerard Martin (Barcelona), but referee Mateo Busquets must have received some information as he makes the VAR signal. He's going to review and it could result in a red card!
47' Hansi Flick is stunned as referee Mateo Busquets shows him a yellow card. What was that for?
46' Gerard Martin (Barcelona) takes out his opponent with an awful tackle and is shown a red card by the referee!
46' Half-time substitution. Fermín is replaced by Ferran Torres (Barcelona).
46' Half-time substitution. Diego Simeone decided to make a change. Koke is replaced by Matteo Ruggeri (Atl. Madrid).
46' Everything is set for the start of the second half.
45+9' The first half of today's match has just finished.
45+8' Marc Bernal (Barcelona) collects the ball from the free kick and immediately sends his close-range effort narrowly wide of the left post!
45+7' The ref makes the signal that the yellow is cancelled but immediately brandishes a straight red to Nicolas Gonzalez (Atl. Madrid). He’s distraught but has to leave the field of play.

45+4' It's been a while since that contentious challenge by Nicolas Gonzalez (Atl. Madrid), but referee Mateo Busquets must have received some information as he makes the VAR signal. He's going to review and it could result in a red card!
45+3' Nicolas Gonzalez (Atl. Madrid) is off! He saw a red card after two yellow cards.
45+1' Joao Cancelo (Barcelona) attempts to send over a cross in order to find one of his teammates, but an opposition defender averts the danger by intercepting the effort.
45+1' Barcelona quickly take a corner kick with a short pass.
45' 3 additional min. will be played.
45' Koke (Atl. Madrid) is booked.
45' Nahuel Molina (Atl. Madrid) picks up a yellow card.
45' Fermín (Barcelona) is awarded a yellow card. The referee showed him no mercy.
42' 1 - 1 Dani Olmo provides Marcus Rashford (Barcelona) with a nice pass inside the box. It allows him to finish with a low shot into the middle of the goal.
41' The referee blows his whistle as Joao Cancelo (Barcelona) was too aggressive in his challenge.
40' Problems for Hansi Flick as Ronald Araujo is not able to play anymore. His injury is too serious and Marc Bernal (Barcelona) replaces him.
39' 1 - 0 Giuliano Simeone (Atl. Madrid) finds himself one-on-one with the keeper after a great pass by Clement Lenglet. He takes the shot early and scores!
38' Eric Garcia (Barcelona) commits a rough challenge and Mateo Busquets blows his whistle for an infringement.
35' Lamine Yamal (Barcelona) receives a decent pass inside the box and curls in an effort on goal, but the ball hits the outside of the right post and flies out of play.
32' Koke (Atl. Madrid) tries to score from mid-range after collecting a rebound, but his shot lacks accuracy and sails high over the bar.
32' The resulting corner from Alex Baena (Atl. Madrid) is cleared by the opposition's defence.
31' A clumsy foul by Antoine Griezmann (Atl. Madrid) and Mateo Busquets blows his whistle.
29' Giuliano Simeone (Atl. Madrid) tries to pass the ball into the penalty area but it's blocked.
28' The linesman raises his flag. Nicolas Gonzalez (Atl. Madrid) is adjudged offside.
26' Nahuel Molina (Atl. Madrid) gets the ball and drives a shot high over the bar from the edge of the area.
22' Nicolas Gonzalez (Atl. Madrid) violates the rules and gets a yellow card.
19' Joao Cancelo (Barcelona) is adjudged to have been offside when making his run.
16' Obed Vargas (Atl. Madrid) is caught offside!
15' Lamine Yamal plays a lovely pass into Fermín (Barcelona), but he can't find the target. His strike from inside the box goes narrowly wide of the left post.
14' Alex Baena (Atl. Madrid) unleashes a shot from a mid-range free kick that goes high over the bar. High, wide and not at all pretty.

12' A defence-splitting pass is taken in his stride by Fermín (Barcelona) in the box. Without even looking up he drills a shot low towards the middle of the goal, but Juan Musso pulls off a comfortable save.
11' Antoine Griezmann (Atl. Madrid) takes a wonderful touch after collecting a pass inside the box. He steers his shot goalwards, but the keeper produces a decent save!
10' Marcus Rashford (Barcelona) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away.
7' Marcus Rashford (Barcelona) stands over the free kick and opts to take it himself, sending it towards the left post only for Juan Musso to dive and make a save.
6' Clement Lenglet (Atl. Madrid) pulls the shirt of his opponent and only escapes without punishment due to the benevolence of the referee. Barcelona are awarded a free kick.
5' Koke (Atl. Madrid) is penalised for a foul. Mateo Busquets had a clear view and blows his whistle.
3' Lamine Yamal (Barcelona) sends in the corner, but the keeper steps in and makes a save.

3' Lamine Yamal (Barcelona) produces an inaccurate low pass into the box that is blocked by the one of the defenders. If this pass had slipped through, the ball would have probably ended up in the back of the net. The ball goes out of play. Barcelona are awarded a corner kick.
